summary: A diarist's view of a public figure changes over the years and the later entries say so.
realLife: Strong's view of Lincoln, whom he voted for in 1860, had turned sour by 1862.
sources: House Divided, Dickinson College, George Templeton Strong's diary, election day 6 Nov 1860: https://hd.housedivided.dickinson.edu/node/34626
Mr. Lincoln and New York, George Templeton Strong (1820 to 1875): https://www.mrlincolnandnewyork.org/new-yorkers/george-templeton-strong-1820-1875/index.html
inGame: The old `memoir-revise` move (an earlier entry revised by what came after) reading the president's record at two dates.
